change.title: RHEL operating system patching — not an executed change
change.purpose: Assess a planned RHEL VM operating system patch owned by the Infra team.
change.scope: OS package and kernel change assessment, host configuration, reboot planning and service validation; application code and image changes are excluded.
change.expectedOutcome: The platform and dependent workloads remain healthy after an independently reviewed, supported change.
change.riskAssessment: Synthetic risk: a reboot, kernel change or package dependency could interrupt hosted services.
change.securityImpact: Not assessed. Record applicable security findings, package provenance and impact to host controls.
change.fallbackPlan: Proposed: establish a tested backup and supported recovery procedure for the affected host and services; package downgrade or snapshot recovery is not assumed safe. No recovery has been tested.

evidence.summary: Illustrative platform change description only; no live inventory, compatibility test, independent approval or execution evidence exists.
